description: Annapurna Ghar Ka Khana - home style veg tiffin for students and office people in HSR Layout and Koramangala. Maharashtrian and North Indian food, cooked fresh every morning by me and my sister. Less oil, less spice, no onion-garlic option on request. Lunch delivered between 12:30 and 1:30, dinner 7:30 to 8:30. Monday to Saturday, Sunday off. Monthly plan is cheapest, you can pause for travel with 1 day notice. Steel tiffin, we collect the empty one next day. Trial meal available.
